item: V3-6 attention-GRN 217M K562 with correct input encoding

model.edge: self_attn weights of model.model.layers[l] (= output_attentions[l]), mean over 8 heads, row = query gene; summed over cells holding both genes and divided by that pair count

genes.rule: top-1,500 variance of log1p(counts / rowsum * 1e4) among var genes in the MaxToki vocabulary (single log)

input_encoding.count_source_description: expm1(X) (X = log1p(CP10k)), checked per row to be whole-number multiples of the cell's smallest non-zero value; by default divided by that value and rounded (= integer counts up to one per-cell factor; expm1_mode='integer')
input_encoding.encoding: counts / row total * 1e4 / Geneformer gc104M gene median, ranked high->low, first max_len-2 genes, <bos>=2 ... <eos>=3 (maxtoki_adapter.tokenize_cell)
